speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any lesions or scaling on the palms and soles of your feet, and have you noticed any hair loss or changes in your fingernails? I am also curious if anyone else in your household is experiencing similar itchy symptoms, especially at night.

text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

text: Given your history of working with livestock on a rice farm, combined with the pruritic rash, hypopigmented macules, and significant hair loss including eyebrows and eyelashes, I suspect a parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin Scraping_Acid_Fast_Stain
